name: archie
description: Talk to Archie, your team's AI teammate, from Claude.

archie_url.title: Archie URL
archie_url.description: Base URL of your Archie server, e.g. https://archie.example.com

tools.name: connect_archie
tools.description: Connect Claude to Archie. The person gets a one-time code by saying "connect claude" to Archie in a Slack DM; pass that code here. Needed once per computer.

tools.name: ask_archie
tools.description: Ask Archie, an AI teammate with access to your company's tools, to do or answer something. Returns at once with a session_id while Archie works in the background, like a subagent. Without session_id it starts a new session; with one it continues that session. Read Archie's replies with check_archie.

tools.name: check_archie
tools.description: See what is new in an Archie session since the last check: Archie's replies, whether it is still working or done, and approvals waiting for the person. While Archie is working it waits up to a minute for something new. Keep calling it until Archie replies, asks for an approval, or has finished; never wait with shell commands.

tools.name: approve_archie
tools.description: Put an Archie approval in front of the person so they can approve or deny it. Only the person decides; you cannot.
